title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Data Science Team Lead

London 3 days

This is an exciting opportunity to lead a growing Data Science function within a professional services organisation investing heavily in AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics. You'll combine team leadership with hands-on delivery across predictive modelling, forecasting, and AI product development.

The Company
This professional services business is expanding its data and AI capabilities, building innovative solutions within a modern Databricks environment. They are investing significantly in AI products and advanced analytics to drive business value across the organisation.
The Role

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2 Data Scientists.
  • Deliver projects across predictive modelling, portfolio modelling, and time-series forecasting.
  • Develop machine learning and AI solutions, including retrieval and extraction use cases.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to identify and deliver high-impact analytics opportunities.
  • Remain hands-on with Python and Databricks development.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Commercial experience in Data Science and Machine Learning.
  • Previous leadership, management, or mentoring experience.
  • Strong Python and Databricks expertise.
  • Experience delivering forecasting and predictive modelling projects.
  • Background within professional services or a consulting environment.
